pattern.name: Chapter gates on an architectural model-making sheet
pattern.description: Shallow arch construction lines, paired registration ticks and a turning route between small chapter stations. Pressed into sage model-making paper, the geometry connects the project's physical gateways with its continuous story timeline; it is unique to Diorama Journey.

framing.note: Uniformly inset the complete approved miniature, with no crop or repositioning of its parts. Preserve the base, arch cap, trees, ring and lantern. Require 128 px clearance from the actual rounded-square outline.

matte.calibrationNote: The modal outer-eight-pixel matte is (251,251,252), with minimum native border channel 241. Seed the real arch opening above the gold ring and the white space inside the ring. The lantern handle contains a physical cream paver behind it (242,226,200 at 964,1150), so it is deliberately not seeded. Warm ivory stone, mint surfaces, brass, highlights and intrinsic model shadows remain opaque; no global white deletion or component cleanup.
